After `graceEndsAt` (the deadline itself for `start_recovery` groups), records a default for each member who has not paid, and the group enters recovery. Nothing is detected while paused. Repeat calls record nothing new.

The member in default pays `DefaultDto.payment` (amount owed, to the escrow, memo of the missed round) the same way as a contribution, then sends the `txHash`. Allowed while the default is open, during a grace extension or after it. Resolves the default; when it was the last open one, recovery ends and the round can pay out.

payment.description: How to pay what you owe now from your wallet; null when nothing is due or not on Stellar.

chainSync.description: Stellar work not yet confirmed (escrow, payouts, anchors); null in simulated mode.

inRecovery.description: True while any default is open: payouts wait for the group's decision.

actionRequired.description: True when the group is in recovery and needs a proposal or vote.

totalContributed.description: Every contribution recorded in the group so far.

totalPaidOut.description: Every payout recorded so far; on Stellar a payment may still be pending (see `chainSync`).

isLive.description: True once the group's escrow account exists on Stellar.

schedule.description:
Payout order as user ids, first recipient first. Required for `manual`
and `custom` payout order; ignored for `random` (shuffled) and `vote`
(join order, changeable by proposal).

txHash.description: Hash of your Stellar payment to the group escrow. Required when the group is live on Stellar.

recorded.description: Defaults recorded by this call; 0 when none were due.

thresholdKind.description: `percent` of the electorate (1-100) or a fixed `count` of yes votes.

votingPeriodHours.description: Hours a proposal stays open for votes.

executionWindowHours.description: Hours after approval during which it can execute.

position.description: 0-based payout round of the slot when listed.

price.description: What the buyer pays the seller when accepting.

creationTxHash.description: Stellar anchor of the `proposal_created` event; null until confirmed or when simulated.

number.description: Per-group sequence, also the on-chain proposal id.

fromRound.description: `update_schedule`: first round to change; must be after the current round.

recipients.description: `update_schedule`: new order of the recipients from `fromRound` onward.

graceUntil.description: `grace_extension`: new deadline for the member to pay (ISO timestamp).

data.description: Keys by `kind` (rounds are 0-based, amounts decimal strings, ids UUIDs): `group_started`: rounds, schedule (user ids, payout order), firstDeadline. `contribution_made`: round, amount, late. `payout_made`: round, recipientId, amount. `group_completed`: rounds. `default_recorded`: round, userId, defaultId, amount. `recovery_started`, `recovery_resolved`: round. `default_resolved`: defaultId, resolution (`settled` | `written_off` | `member_removed`); round when settled; proposalId when decided by vote. `proposal_created`, `proposal_executed`: proposalId, number, type. `vote_cast`: proposalId, number, choice, yes, no. `proposal_approved`, `proposal_rejected`: proposalId, number, yes, no, required; reason `electorate changed` when a removal decided it. `proposal_expired`: proposalId, reason. `group_paused`: proposalId. `group_resumed`: proposalId, newDeadline. `schedule_updated`: proposalId, fromRound, recipients. `member_removed`: userId, proposalId. Events recorded before a key was added may lack it.

txHash.description: Stellar transaction: the payment itself, or the anchor of this event. Null until confirmed.

anchorHash.description:
sha256 of the event's canonical JSON, written as the anchor transaction's
memo hash. Recompute it to verify the record on Stellar. Null for payments.

group.description: Set for contributions, payouts and slot purchases/sales.

plan.description: Set for savings deposits and withdrawals.

txUrl.description: Explorer link; null until `txHash` is a confirmed Stellar hash.

txHash.description:
Stellar transaction hash. A payout shows a `payout:` placeholder until
its payment confirms; simulated groups show `simulated:` ids.

slotPurchases.description: Asking prices you paid for slots you took over.

slotSales.description: Asking prices you received for slots you sold.

transactions.description: Oldest first. The frontend renders these as CSV.

totals.description: Over the whole period, even when `transactions` is truncated.

truncated.description: True when the period has more than 10,000 rows; narrow the dates.

expiresAt.description: The buyer can accept until then.

acceptable.description: The listing is still open and the approval has not expired: the buyer can accept now.

message.description: What the API answers when this check fails.

eligible.description: Every check passes, so the action will not be refused for these rules.

totalRounds.description: Slots in the schedule, which is also the number of rounds.

roundDeadline.description: When the current round's contributions are due.

requests.description: Pending requests; only for the seller.

transfer.description: The transfer the seller chose to put to a vote, if any; visible to the seller, the chosen buyer and members.

buyerEligibility.description: Whether you could request a takeover now; null for the seller and for closed listings.

roundsToPay.description: Rounds the buyer would still pay for (the current one is skipped when the seller already paid it).

expectedPayout.description: Contribution × rounds: the payout when every member pays.

requested.description: You have a pending takeover request on it.

askingPrice.description: What a buyer pays you when the takeover completes. `"0"` gives the slot away.

position.description: 0-based payout round of your slot; null when you hold none.

eligible.description: Every check passes, so the action will not be refused for these rules.

payout.description: The slot's payout, once its round paid out (to whoever held it then).

position.description: 0-based payout round of the slot when it moved.

paidBySeller.description: What the seller had paid into the group before selling.

selling.description: Listings you created, any status, newest first.

buying.description: Listings you requested, were chosen for, or bought, any status, newest first.

xdr.description: Unsigned transaction (base64 XDR) for the wallet to sign.

ownerAddress.description: Wallet that owns the plan on Stellar and must sign its movements; null in simulated mode.

movements.description: Newest first; only on the detail endpoint.

progressPercent.description: Balance as a share of the target, 0 to 100 (capped), two decimals.

canWithdraw.description: The lock allows a withdrawal now (and the balance is above 0).

xdr.description: Sign this, then call `POST /savings/plans/{planId}/confirm`. Null in simulated mode.

plan.description: Simulated mode: the plan, already created.

planId.description: Id of the plan the transaction creates.

lock.description:
`flexible`: withdraw any time. `until_date`: from `unlockAt`.
`until_target`: while the balance is at least the target.
`until_date_or_target`: whichever comes first.

unlockAt.description: Required for the date locks, otherwise rejected. In the future, at most 10 years ahead.

groups.description: Group savings: the same figures as `GET /groups/overview`.

totalSaved.description:
Group `totalSaved` (contributed to groups not yet completed, before
payouts) plus personal `balance` (held in plans now).

xdr.description: Unsigned transaction (base64 XDR) for the wallet to sign and submit.

data.description: Ids for deep links. Every kind has `groupId`. Also: `round` (0-based): `contribution_missed`, `recovery_started`, `payout_received`. `proposalId`: `proposal_created`, `proposal_approved`, `proposal_rejected`, `proposal_executed`. `userId` (the person to review): `group_join_requested`, `group_member_joined`. No other keys are sent.

status.description: Always `ok` here; when a dependency is down the API answers 503 instead.

details.description: Validation messages, one per failed constraint.
